_comment: Illustrative criteria only, not executed evidence. Replace with the user's actual requirements and real references. Evidence kinds: test (path::name or path::Class::method, exact parameter id when applicable, matched to a passing testcase in the linked check's JUnit report), check (a recorded check id; proves only that check's scope), artifact (file under the run or repo), review (manual note = weak). Tags drive coverage hints: concurrency, rollback, migration, contract, authz, ui-state, a11y, failure, money, idempotency, regression. preservation/refactor tags additionally require the paired baseline below; copy baseline_state exactly from the baseline test check's details.source_state. The same exact tests must pass before/after with unchanged test sources. A bugfix regression may fail before the fix and is separate from preservation.

criteria.text: Sending the same create-order request twice (same Idempotency-Key) creates one order
Two buyers of the last item: exactly one succeeds, stock never negative
User A cannot read or export user B's orders; denied requests change nothing
Order list shows loading, empty and error states and is usable with the keyboard
Existing order totals, errors and side effects stay unchanged outside the requested fix
